title: MS NDE 4745
content: My mother was brushing my long hair prior to school, I was five years old. It was tangled, and she pulled and tugged at my hair to smooth it out. I was standing at the time and I recall looking down our hallway from the living room, where I was standing. Suddenly I remember feeling as if I were floating, I looked down I couldn't see my feet but I knew I was looking down where they would be. I felt a magnetic pull down towards the hallway. I felt a pull that I couldn't break from. I was moving fast. I was going through a dark hallway, I could hear other voices of people, I didn't know whom they were, and I was frightened. The voices of the people sounded like they were confused and didn't understand what was happening to them. I didn't get to travel very far, but I remember it being dark and feeling afraid. I looked at myself but there was nothing physical to see, but I knew I was looking at myself. As I was traveling I heard my mother sobbing and I turned around and a few feet away, I saw myself lying on the floor lifeless and my mother crying over me. Suddenly a voice said to me, a voice that I could hear only in my head, 'If you continue you can never return.' Seeing my mother sob was so horrible, I ran as hard as I could towards my physical self but I didn't know what to do. A thought in me said jump in, I tried but felt I bounced off. Again, the thought, try harder, and then it worked. I recall sitting on a window sill, the window open and my mother sobbing, and fanning me.

out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Felt 'as if I were floating' and a 'magnetic pull' down the hallway.

tunnel.passage_other_detail: Moving fast through a dark hallway.

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Tried to 'jump in' but 'bounced off'; then 'try harder' and it worked.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Collapsed as a child while mother was brushing hair; described as lying on the floor 'lifeless' (no medical details given).

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Heard voices of other people while moving through the dark hallway; saw mother crying over body; returned by 'jumping in'.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE with movement through a dark hallway (tunnel-like), then boundary warning, then return to body.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Return attempt described as bouncing off the body before successfully re-entering; later remembers sitting on a window sill with the window open while mother fanned them.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: 'If you continue you can never return.'
